description: One real preparation action and one real consumption action, both bound to the resident's own saved home/work point (the same point the world's own workstation rule uses). `warm:prepare` needs a body inside 2.5 m of that point, spends 60 s of real world time there, CONSUMES exactly one existing ration from the resident's own survival account at completion and creates exactly one new held item (`warm_meal_<serial>`); it never eats on preparation. `warm:eat:<meal_id>` needs the same body position, spends 20 s, consumes that one held item and restores satiety (50 fresh, 25 after the 3600 s world-time freshness window) and nothing else: no food unit, energy, money or material is created. A preparation whose body stops making real progress toward its own work point closes once as `warm_meal_blocked` with no ration consumed and no item created. All new state lives in its own `godot.warm_food` namespace, so no base namespace that rejects unknown job types is asked to hold one; validation runs on load and on every transaction and refuses a prepared meal that is neither held nor eaten exactly once, a pending command without its job, a rewritten freshness deadline, or a job placed away from the resident's own work point.
